description: This script defines a test suite for verifying handling of long file paths in a Git index, utilizing functions and behaviors from an external test library. It sets up test paths and objects, then performs tests to ensure overly long paths are processed correctly.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case with a description and a script to execute as part of the testing framework.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality in tests.
